issue_context.title: Enable `unusedwrite` and `appends` linter
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

The linters [unusedwrite](https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/tools@v0.20.0/go/analysis/passes/unusedwrite) and [appends](https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/tools@v0.20.0/go/analysis/passes/appends) can help us to locate some meaningless codes and find potential bugs (e.g. https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/52449). We could enable them by default.

review_comments: Because it's not used in this test :thinking: .
Well, that test passes. I guess this will probably be fine.
